name: Raúl Mendoza
bio:
Raúl's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through a family legacy or childhood karting dreams, but through a chance encounter with a local racing team while working at an auto body shop. Intrigued by the intricate carbon fiber work on the race cars, he volunteered his time, quickly demonstrating a knack for composite repair and fabrication. He is eager to learn and contribute to a team's success. 

While his technical skills are still developing, Raúl compensates with his meticulous attention to detail and unwavering dedication to quality. He understands the critical role composites play in performance and safety and approaches each task with a sense of responsibility. Raúl is known for his positive attitude and willingness to go the extra mile, making him a valuable asset to any team looking to nurture young talent.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave.
physical.description: Raúl is of average height with a lean build and a friendly smile.

quirks: Always brings a thermos of strong coffee to the workshop.
Has a collection of miniature racing car models on his workbench.
Meticulously cleans his tools after every use.
